name: 3D Half-Gaussian Splatting Covariance Transformation and Regularization
aliases: 3D Half-Gaussian Splatting (3D-HGS) Covariance Transformation and Regularization
summary: 3D Half-Gaussian Splatting Covariance Transformation and Regularization modifies Gaussian covariance matrices into half-ellipsoids to model sharp surface boundaries, distinguishing itself by applying structural constraints directly to parameters rather than using auxiliary loss terms.
